verdict.summary: The enforced coverage-cone wiring is fail-safe and internally consistent. Narrowing occurs only for an explicit selected mode with a non-empty, well-formed affected closure; all other selector states and write failures leave an empty filter, which coverage.sh treats as a full-shard run. The shell intersection preserves explicit COVERAGE_CRATES remeasurement, handles whitespace-only filters, records inherited crates in the summary, and keeps measured below-floor crates failing. The added tests exercise the actual CLI and coverage.sh selection path, including full/error fallbacks, disjoint shards, reporting, and gate labeling. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test defect is evident in the diff.
